candidates.name: Mozdok-Grozny Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: Length 101.7 km, diameter 720 mm; Chechnya connected to the Mozdok trunk system.
Gazprom completed construction of Mozdok-Grozny main gas pipeline, 101.73 km, supplies Grozny TPP.
Item 'Магистральный газопровод Моздок - Грозный' in the federal pipeline territorial plan (816-r as amended 17.12.2025), 4.345 bcm/y average, Mozdok district to Grozny district.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No Mozdok-Grozny row in roster; P0751/P1471/P2343 are other Mozdok-area trunks (Kazimagomed-Mozdok, Novopskov-Aksai-Mozdok, Mozdok-Nevinnomyssk). Distinct 101.7 km line built 2018-2021.

candidates.name: Krasnodar Krai-Crimea Gas Pipeline
candidates.from: Southern Corridor between Kazachya and Russkaya compressor stations, Krasnodar Krai (Taman peninsula)
candidates.to: Simferopol / Sevastopol, Crimea (Ukraine per naming conventions)

evidence.note: Length 358.7 km incl. two-string Tuzla/Kerch Strait crossing and 27.3 km Simferopol branch; 2.2 bcm/y.
~400 km; Krasnodar Krai-Kerch 137.5 km, Kerch-Simferopol ~240 km, Simferopol-Sevastopol 56 km; commissioned 27 Dec 2016; 700/500 mm; two 16 km Kerch Strait strings.
Launch of the Krasnodar Krai-Crimea main gas pipeline.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No Krasnodar Krai-Crimea row in roster (P1470/P5551 are Krasnodar-Serpukhov). RU-UA cross-border per naming conventions (UKR terminus). OSM seed Краснодарський край - Крим ~135 km matches only the Russian-side Krasnodar-Kerch section; P1470 name_hint is a false match. Length ~359-400 km depending on source.

candidates.name: Anapa-Taman Gas Pipeline
candidates.from: Anapa area (Russkaya/Southern Corridor junction near Novorossiysk-Anapa)
candidates.to: Taman, Temryuk district (OTEKO industrial park area)

evidence.note: Anapa-Taman main gas pipeline, 106 km, part of the Southern Gas Transport Corridor, commissioned 2016; first-stage expansion adds 16.7 km in the same corridor.
Expansion connects to Pisarevka-Anapa and Pochinki-Anapa; Glavgosexpertiza approval 29 May 2023.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Roster has Pisarevka-Anapa (P2426) and Pochinki-Anapa (P2425) ending at Anapa but nothing Anapa-Taman. Possibly folded into P2426 or Krasnodar-Crimea feeder; consolidator to check.

candidates.name: Anapa-Taman Gas Pipeline Expansion (Stage II/III loop)
candidates.sponsor: Gazprom Invest (designer Gazprom Proektirovanie, contractor Gazstroyprom)

evidence.note: Expansion section km 16.0-104.1 (88.1 km), +7.5 bcm/y, parallel to existing Anapa-Taman line.
Item 'Расширение газопровода Анапа - Тамань' in the federal pipeline plan, 7.5 bcm/y; separate item 18 for SW Krasnodar Krai supply up to 5 bcm/y.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Looping of the Anapa-Taman line; depends on whether the parent is captured. Status construction vs proposed unclear.

candidates.name: Shakhty-Volgodonsk Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: Shakhty-Volgodonsk gas pipeline is Volgodonsk's sole gas source; capacity expansion with parallel pipeline option designed 2015.
Federal plan item for expansion of gas transport capacity on the Shakhty-Volgodonsk section for central Rostov Oblast (Zimovniki, Dubovsky, Volgodonskoy districts).

candidates.why_maybe_new: No Shakhty-Volgodonsk row in roster (P2381/P5665 Rostov-Maykop are different). Length unknown (not stated in sources; likely well over 25 km given Shakhty-Volgodonsk distance). Expansion status unconfirmed.

candidates.name: Khasavyurt-Novolak Gas Branch Pipeline (Novolak branch)

evidence.note: Reconstruction complete: new 325 mm, 29.3 km branch on a new route replacing 159 mm line of 1986.
Federal plan item: reconstruction of gas branch to Novolak village, Novolaksky district.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Branch from P0751 trunk; no Dagestan branch rows in roster. Original 1986 branch length unknown; new route 29.3 km.

candidates.name: Krasnodar-Krymsk Gas Pipeline
candidates.to: Krymsk (feeds Ilsky refinery branch, Seversky district)

evidence.note: Federal plan item: reconstruction of section of main gas pipeline 'Krasnodar - Krymsk' (Seversky district), 0.27 bcm/y, supply to Ilsky refinery.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster; may be a segment of P1470/P5551 Krasnodar Krai-Serpukhov or Pisarevka/Pochinki-Anapa feeders. Length unknown; single master-plan evidence only. Weak lead.

candidates.name: Berdyansk-Melitopol Gas Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: Russian Ministry of Energy / Zaporizhzhia occupation administration

evidence.note: New main pipeline over 100 km from Berdyansk to Melitopol, extending the Taganrog-Mariupol-Berdyansk line.

candidates.why_maybe_new: out_of_slice: wholly inside occupied Ukraine (Ukraine-internal per naming conventions). May be part of P5989 Taganrog-Melitopol-Berdyansk (route/name overlap); P7817/P7818 cover Taganrog-Mariupol-Berdyansk.

candidates.name: Glebovka-Simferopol-Sevastopol Gas Pipeline (Phase 3)

evidence.note: Federal plan item: third phase, 102 km, 500 mm, 8.193 mcm/d, Bakhchisaray/Saki/Simferopol districts and Sevastopol.

candidates.why_maybe_new: out_of_slice: wholly inside Crimea (Ukraine-internal per naming conventions); not in roster. Also Yalta-Foros-Sevastopol Yalta-Veseloye section is 25.6 km (borderline length).
